PreToolUse.description: Run full local CI (lint + tests + coverage ≥80%) before git add/commit/push — aligned with GitHub Actions

_comment: Pre-commit hook — blocks agent from staging, committing, or pushing code that fails lint analysis, test suite, or coverage threshold (≥80%). Trigger: PreToolUse event on `git add`, `git commit`, or `git push`. Timeout: 120s. Runs /`make ci` which matches CI pipeline exactly.
